title: Greek Potato Stew
description: TIP: You can use leftover chicken for this, but do remember any leftover soup must be discarded as chicken should not be reheated more than once.

ingredients.text: 300ml vegetable stock (1 vegetable stock cube dissolved in 300ml boiling water)
65g reduced-fat Greek-style salad cheese or reduced-fat feta

steps: Spray a saucepan with low-calorie cooking spray and place over a medium heat.
Add the sliced onions and pepper and sauté for 8 minutes, until soft, then add the garlic and oregano and cook for a further minute or two.
Add the tomatoes and stock and stir in the potatoes.
Bring to the boil, then reduce the heat to medium-low, cover and simmer for 25 minutes, until the potatoes are almost cooked.
Stir in the olives and lemon juice and continue cooking, uncovered, for another 10 minutes, or until a knife slides easily into the potatoes.
Season with a little black pepper, then crumble the Greek-style salad cheese or feta on top.
